ache.title: A “free” S-rank, paid for with your dailies
ache.note: ‘Get an S-Rank Character for Free!’ says the title, then the guide walks through daily tasks, coupon management and Potential Awakened missions, or the early banner if you can’t wait. That’s the free-character trick: it costs you a run of daily logins, and a banner sits right there to skip the wait.
watch: an early banner to skip the grind
coupons to manage like a budget
ache.tip: If a free character needs a daily routine you don’t enjoy, it isn’t free. It’s fine to let it pass.
lines: you don’t owe the event your mornings

videoData.title: S Verthandi Event Made Easy! Get an S-Rank Character for Free! | Aether Gazer

textData.text: In today's video, I discuss S Verthandi, the new version of the protagonist in Aether Gazer. I provide a comprehensive guide on how to obtain and play this character, covering details about accessing early and permanent content, using the banners for character pulls, and unlocking the character through the Potential Awakened mode. I go step-by-step through the various missions and challenges, including tips for daily tasks and coupon management, to ensure you can successfully get S Verthandi. Whether you're accessing from the early banner or grinding through the event, this video has all the information you need.
